en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; I cannot name an author. The list names women from towns across Macedonia (e.g. стружанка = woman from Struga). 'Дулак' is a bride's veil (source note).

words_to_learn.en: to relieve, to take over from

lines.cyr: - Ожени се, мили сине, ти не чекај,
lines.lat: - Oženi se, mili sine, ti ne čekaj,
lines.en: - Get married, dear son, do not wait,

lines.cyr: зошто време, сине, не те чека.
lines.lat: zošto vreme, sine, ne te čeka.
lines.en: because time, son, does not wait for you.
To relieve your old mother, son,
and to open up the house, son.
- Here, mother, I have decided

lines.cyr: да се женам, мајко, да не чекам.
lines.lat: da se ženam, majko, da ne čekam.
lines.en: to marry, mother, not to wait.

lines.cyr: Туку, се плашам да не згрешам,
lines.lat: Tuku, se plašam da ne zgrešam,
lines.en: But I fear I may err,

lines.cyr: од кај мома, мајко, јас да земам?
lines.lat: od kaj moma, majko, jas da zemam?
lines.en: from where, mother, shall I take a girl?
Shall she be from Struga, or from Ohrid,
from Resen, or from Bitola?
From Prilep, or from Tikveš,
from Strumica, or from Štip?
From Kočani, or from Veles,
from Debar, or from Kičevo?
From Gostivar, or from Tetovo,
from Kumanovo, or from Skopje?

lines.cyr: - Нека биде, сине, од кај сакаш,
lines.lat: - Neka bide, sine, od kaj sakaš,
lines.en: - Let her be, son, from wherever you like,
only let her be, son, a good housewife.
To relieve your old mother, son,
and to cheer up the house, son.
Let the drums sound,
let the wedding guests gather.
I will lead the dance, dear son,
and welcome the bride, son.
I will take out a silk veil for her,

lines.cyr: да ми бакне, сине, десна рака.
lines.lat: da mi bakne, sine, desna raka.
lines.en: so she may kiss my right hand.
So she may kiss my right hand

lines.cyr: и да умрам, сине, да не жалам.
lines.lat: i da umram, sine, da ne žalam.
lines.en: and I may die, son, without regret.
